files.label: config
files.text:
# Agent desk: nord, agents and their states.
# The look of the "agents" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.


[appearance]
theme = "nord"
background = "theme"
border_style = "rounded"
border_unfocused_color = "#4c566a"
window_title_style = "pill"
dockbar_position = "top"

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = true
row_style = "pill"
header_style = "icon"
density = "roomy"
show_agents = true

files.label: config
files.text:
# Retro amber: amber-crt, a custom theme.
# The look of the "amber" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.
# Copy amber-crt.json to ~/.config/tuios/themes/.


[appearance]
theme = "amber-crt"
pane_background = "theme"
desktop_background = "theme"
window_chrome_background = "theme"
border_style = "double"
window_title_style = "plain"
glyphs = "ascii"
dockbar_position = "top"
dock_pill_caps = false

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = true
row_style = "marker"
header_style = "plain"
header_case = "uppercase"
background = "theme"



[dock]

[dock.tabs]
style = "flat"
separator = " | "

files.label: config
files.text:
# Cozy pastel: mocha-peach, a custom theme.
# The look of the "cozy" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.
# Copy mocha-peach.json to ~/.config/tuios/themes/.


[appearance]
theme = "mocha-peach"
background = "theme"
border_style = "rounded"
border_focused_gradient = "accent magenta"
border_gradient_angle = 45
window_title_style = "pill"
dockbar_position = "top"

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = true
row_style = "pill"
header_style = "icon"
density = "roomy"

files.label: config

files.label: config

files.label: config
files.text:
# Minimal mono: mono-ink, a custom theme.
# The look of the "mono" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.
# Copy mono-ink.json to ~/.config/tuios/themes/.


[appearance]
theme = "mono-ink"
background = "theme"
border_style = "normal"
window_title_style = "plain"
window_title_align = "left"
hide_window_buttons = true
glyphs = "ascii"
dockbar_position = "bottom"
dock_compact = true
dock_pill_caps = false

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = false

files.label: config
files.text:
# Neon: neon theme, thick gradient borders.
# The look of the "neon" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.


[appearance]
theme = "neon"
background = "theme"
border_style = "thick"
border_focused_gradient = "#f924e7 #00fffc"
border_gradient_angle = 0
border_unfocused_color = "#3a2d4a"
window_title_style = "tab"
glyphs = "heavy"
dockbar_position = "top"

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = true
row_style = "marker"
header_style = "rule"

files.label: config
files.text:
# Omarchy style: tokyo night, flat tabs, gaps.
# The look of the "omarchy" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.


[appearance]
theme = "tokyo_night"
background = "theme"
border_style = "rounded"
border_unfocused_color = "#3b4261"
window_title_style = "plain"
window_title_align = "center"
dockbar_position = "top"
dock_workspace_tab_format = "{icon}"
gap = 1

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = true
row_style = "bar"
header_style = "rule"
header_case = "uppercase"



[dock]

[dock.tabs]
style = "flat"
separator = "  "
number_glyphs = ["一", "二", "三"]
active_bold = true

files.label: config
files.text:
# Scrolling: gruvbox, columns that scroll.
# The look of the "scroll" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.


[appearance]
theme = "gruvbox_dark"
background = "theme"
border_style = "rounded"
window_title_style = "tab"
dockbar_position = "bottom"
border_unfocused_color = "bright_black"

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = false



[startup]
layout = "scrolling"

files.label: config
files.text:
# Zen: kanagawa, one pane, nothing else.
# The look of the "zen" rice from the film. Paste into ~/.config/tuios/config.toml.


[appearance]
theme = "kanagawa"
background = "theme"
border_style = "hidden"
window_title_position = "hidden"
hide_window_buttons = true
dockbar_position = "bottom"
dock_compact = true

[appearance.sidebar]
enabled = false
